column1: # DS01 per-sample CAZy family abundance (Bowtie2 read counts)
# Generated 2026-09-03 from the REBUILT catalogue (unique sample-prefixed IDs).
# Method: Bowtie2 of each sample's host-depleted reads onto the non-redundant gene
# catalogue (93.2-95.1% overall alignment rate), counts per gene via samtools
# idxstats, joined to CAZy families from the eggNOG-mapper CAZy column.
# COMPARABILITY WARNING: the CAZy families here come from eggNOG (26,439 of
# 2,052,794 genes carry a CAZy tag). The DS02/DS03 vendor tables use DIAMOND
# against the full CAZy database, which is far more sensitive for CAZymes
# specifically. The two annotations are NOT interchangeable - normalising GH18
# to total CAZy gives ~15,500 ppm here versus ~509 (DS02) and ~312 (DS03), a
# 30-50x gap that is an annotation-coverage artefact, not biology.
# Do not plot these against the vendor values on one axis.
